caption: Save this & follow for more easy toddler recipes 💛 Cloud cottage cheese pancakes ☁️🥞 These are SO fluffy and packed with protein—perfect for your toddler and you. ✨ Ingredients: - 1 cup cottage cheese   - 1 egg   - 1/2 banana   - 1/3 cup all-purpose flour   - 1/2 tsp baking powder   - Splash of milk   Blend, cook on low-medium heat, and watch them puff up 💫   Top with yogurt + fruit (and maple syrup for older toddlers or you 😉) So yummy for the whole family #toddlerrecipes #toddlermealideas #easyrecipe #toddlersnack #toddlerbreakfast
